text:
alex: Quick sync re: Redwood POC with North Ridge — need clarity on SDK init + streaming auth and what telemetry we can surface to the customer during trial. TL;DR: they want ephemeral creds, per-route latency, and a minimal sample to prove function-calls + structured output.
maria_se: Got it. Are they using SSO for onboarding (SAML/OAuth) or want short-lived API keys for the app server? Also confirm EU data residency requirement.
alex: They want SAML SSO for admin console + ephemeral creds for backend service to open websockets. EU residency required for production, trial can be US.
tim_infra: Ephemeral creds: we can do short-lived tokens (1h) via STS-style flow. Devs will call our token service with signed client assertion. Example curl flow we've used before:
```
# client -> our-token-service
POST /token
{ "grant_type":"client_assertion", "assertion":"<jwt-signed-by-customer>" }
# returns {"access_token":"ey..","expires_in":3600}
```
That token is acceptable for streaming and function calls; it scopes to route and project.
ella_devex: For the SDK init, use the client-side snippet below — it supports streaming and function-calls out of the box. We should share a tiny example repo.
```
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN });
const s = await client.stream("/chat", { model: "redwood-legacy" });
s.on("data", (chunk) => console.log(chunk));
```
maria_se: Telemetry: they specifically asked for per-route p50/p95 latency, tokens per request, and websocket connection health. We can expose those as dashboard widgets in Console (token breakdown + latency by route). Is the trial tenant able to see those metrics or do we need to enable a flag?
tim_infra: Metrics available via Console for all hosted trials. For Dedicated/Private we'd need to enable remote metrics ingestion (they asked about sending to their Datadog). We can forward metrics via StatsD/OTLP. Quick note: websocket connection metrics use our internal heartbeat; if they're doing edge proxies, that will affect p95.
alex: Pricing question from procurement: trial usage looks like spikey streaming. How do we show cost estimate? They asked: "if we go to dedicated how much to reserve" — they want a 99% latency SLO and predictable unit price.
maria_se: For presales, give them two options: (1) hosted pay-as-you-go (per-token + egress) with projected monthly spend based on sample traffic; (2) Dedicated reserved nodes — example: 2x A100 reserved gives X qps and we can offer an introductory commit discount. I'll attach a sample calc offline.
ella_devex: I'll prepare a minimal runbook for the POC: SDK init snippet, ephemeral token flow, example function-call JSON, and a small telemetry dashboard template. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Will include a sample structured output schema for their reconciliation use-case.
alex: Perfect. Last blocker: security questionnaire asks about KMS integration (customer-managed key), IP allowlist for websocket endpoints, and SOC2. Can we answer now?
tim_infra: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM for Private; Hosted supports envelope encryption with customer-managed keys in KSAs for enterprise tenants. IP allowlist: yes for dedicated and as an allowlist for tenant control plane. SOC2: we publish report under NDA.
maria_se: I'll reply to the customer's sec team with that language and ask for the security questionnaire PDF. alex please confirm we should cc Solutions Architect from today
alex: Yes — cc @ella_devex and @tim_infra. I'll respond to procurement with the two pricing options. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for trial tenant (tenant-id: nr-poc). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/nr-poc/telemetry
